_README: DMV (DC / Maryland / Virginia) high school basketball prospects — the canonical entity. First 3 records are fictional SAMPLES (named *Sample/Placeholder/Example). The rest are REAL prospects auto-promoted from Capitol Hoops rosters (source: 'capitol-hoops-2026') — factual bio only, evaluation fields null until authored. `id` is a lowercase-alphanumeric slug of the name (join key, matches prospectFilm.json and capitolHoops.json).

_schema.name: Full name
_schema.position: PG | SG | SF | PF | C (combos allowed)
_schema.county: County (PG, Montgomery, Fairfax, etc.) — powers the DMV map later
_schema.headshot: URL to headshot image (null = initials fallback)
_schema.source: Provenance tag, e.g. 'capitol-hoops-2026' for auto-promoted stubs (optional)
_schema.comp: { player, note } — single authored pro/college stylistic comparison (eye-test, not computed)
_schema.statLines: Array of stat sets by context (HS Season / Summer (AAU) / Fall League). Each: { context, season, team, league, gp, stats: { ppg, rpg, apg, spg, bpg, fgPct, threePct, ftPct } }
